blocks.text: Oldingi darsda odamlar va geografik nomlar ko'rildi (→ 77-dars), qizil kitobda esa ko'cha, muzey va mehmonxonalar haqida qisqacha aytilgan (→ qizil kitob, 73-dars). Bu darsda — shahar ichidagi nomlar: ko'cha, bino, mehmonxona, muzey, universitet, do'kon, gazeta va tashkilotlar. Asosiy kalit — nomning **birinchi so'zi**. U **atoqli ot** (odam yoki joy nomi) bo'lsa, odatda the yo'q: **Heathrow** Airport, **Samarkand** State University. U **oddiy so'z** (sifat yoki ot) bo'lsa yoki nomda **of** bo'lsa — the bor: **the White** House, **the** University **of** Oxford.

Ko'cha, shoh ko'cha, maydon va park nomlari odatda artiklsiz: **Navoi Street**, **Amir Temur Avenue**, **Independence Square**, **Oxford Street**, **Baker Street**, **Hyde Park**, **Gafur Gulom Park**, **Broadway**. O'zbekcha «Navoiy ko'chasi» kabi, nomning o'zi ko'chani aniq ko'rsatadi. Istisnolar kam, lekin Britaniyada tez-tez eshitiladi: **the High Street** (shaharchaning bosh ko'chasi), Londondagi **the Mall** va **the Strand**, avtomagistrallar — **the M25**, **the M1**, **the A1**. Tarixiy yo'l ham the bilan: **the Silk Road**.

items.text: The museum is on **Amir Temur Avenue**, about five minutes from the metro.
items.translation: Muzey **Amir Temur shoh ko'chasida**, metrodan besh daqiqacha narida.

items.text: Turn left into **Baker Street** and you'll see the café on your right.
items.translation: **Beyker-stritga** chapga buriling, kafeni o'ng tomonda ko'rasiz.

items.text: Take **the M6** north if you're driving from London to Manchester.
items.translation: Londondan Manchesterga mashinada borayotgan bo'lsangiz, shimolga qarab **M6** avtomagistralidan yuring.

blocks.text: Ikki so'zli nomlar: Buckingham Palace, lekin the White House

Ko'p nomlar ikki qismdan iborat: **nom + oddiy ot** (Airport, Station, University, Palace, Castle, Abbey, Bazaar). Birinchi so'z joy yoki odamning nomi bo'lsa — the yo'q: **Tashkent International Airport**, **Heathrow Airport**, **Victoria Station**, **Edinburgh Castle**, **Buckingham Palace**, **Westminster Abbey**, **Samarkand State University**, **Chorsu Bazaar**. Birinchi so'z oddiy sifat yoki ot bo'lsa — **the**: **the White House**, **the Royal Palace**, **the National Library**, **the Japanese Garden**, **the Open University**. Taqqoslang: **Gafur Gulom** Park (shoir nomi) — **the Botanical** Garden (oddiy sifat).

items.text: Our hotel is just a short walk from **Victoria Station**.
items.translation: Mehmonxonamiz **Viktoriya vokzalidan** bir necha qadam narida.

items.text: You need to book months in advance to visit **the White House**.
items.translation: **Oq uyga** tashrif buyurish uchun bir necha oy oldin yozilish kerak.

items.text: Nilufar teaches Uzbek literature at **Fergana State University**.
items.translation: Nilufar **Farg'ona davlat universitetida** o'zbek adabiyotidan dars beradi.

blocks.text: Ko'prik va minoralarda qo'llanish turlicha, ularni alohida eslab qolish kerak: **Tower Bridge**, **London Bridge**, **Waterloo Bridge** — the siz; **the Golden Gate Bridge**, **the Eiffel Tower**, **the Leaning Tower of Pisa** — the bilan. O'zbekistondagi tarixiy obidalar ham inglizcha matnlarda ikki xil yoziladi: **the Registan** / **Registan Square**, **the Kalyan Minaret** / **Kalyan Minaret**. Bunday hollarda ishonchli manbadagi shaklni ishlating.
Mehmonxona, muzey, teatr, kinoteatr — the bilan

Mehmonxona, muzey, galereya, teatr va kinoteatr nomlari odatda **the** bilan — birinchi so'z atoqli ot bo'lsa ham: **the Hilton**, **the Hyatt Regency**, **the Ritz**, **the British Museum**, **the Louvre**, **the National Gallery**, **the Amir Temur Museum**, **the Navoi Theatre**, **the Ilkhom Theatre**, **the Odeon**. Oddiy ot (Hotel, Theatre, Cinema) ko'pincha tushib qoladi, **the** esa qoladi: We're staying at **the Hilton**. Boshqa mashhur binolar ham ko'pincha shunday: **the Empire State Building**, **the Kremlin**, **the Shard**.

Nomda **of** bo'lsa, deyarli doim **the**: **the Bank of England**, **the Tower of London**, **the Great Wall of China**, **the Museum of Applied Arts**, **the National University of Uzbekistan**, **the Palace of Westminster**, **the Gulf of Mexico**. Universitetlarning ko'pincha ikki nomi bor va ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: **Oxford University** = **the University of Oxford**, **Edinburgh University** = **the University of Edinburgh**. Birinchisida boshida shahar nomi turibdi (the siz), ikkinchisida — **of** (the bilan).

items.text: My cousin has won a scholarship to **the University of Manchester**.
items.translation: Amakivachcham **Manchester universitetida** o'qish uchun grant yutib oldi.

items.text: **The Great Wall of China** was built over many centuries.
items.translation: **Buyuk Xitoy devori** ko'p asrlar davomida qurilgan.

items.text: Is the conference at **the National University of Uzbekistan** or at **Inha University**?

blocks.text: Asoschisining nomi bilan atalgan do'kon, restoran va banklar ko'pincha `-'s` yoki `-s` bilan tugaydi va the olmaydi: **McDonald's**, **Harrods**, **Sainsbury's**, **Barclays**, **Lloyds**. Avliyo nomi bilan atalgan cherkov va soborlar ham shunday: **St Paul's Cathedral**, **St Andrew's Church**. Kompaniya va aviakompaniyalar nomi — the siz: **Samsung**, **Google**, **Apple**, **Uzbekistan Airways**, **British Airways**, **Korzinka**.

Gazeta nomlari — **the** bilan: **the Times**, **the Guardian**, **the Financial Times**, **the Daily Telegraph**. Jurnallar ko'pincha the siz: **Time**, **Vogue**, **National Geographic** (lekin **the Economist**). Tashkilotlar — **the** bilan: **the United Nations**, **the European Union**, **the Red Cross**, **the World Bank**, **the World Health Organization**. Qisqartma harfma-harf o'qilsa, the saqlanadi: **the UN**, **the EU**, **the BBC**, **the WHO**. Qisqartma bitta so'zdek o'qilsa — the yo'q: **NATO**, **UNESCO**, **UNICEF**, **NASA**. Yangiliklar saytlari ham the siz: **Kun.uz**, **Gazeta.uz**.

rows: so'zdek o'qiladigan qisqartma: NATO, UNESCO, NASA

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «on the Navoi Street» → **on Navoi Street**; «at the Heathrow Airport» → **at Heathrow Airport**; «I study at the Samarkand State University» → **at Samarkand State University**; «We stayed at Hilton» → **at the Hilton**; «in British Museum» → **in the British Museum**; «at University of Oxford» → **at the University of Oxford**; «I read Guardian» → **I read the Guardian**; «the NATO», «the UNESCO» → **NATO**, **UNESCO**; «BBC says» → **the BBC says**; «the McDonald's» → **McDonald's**.

Nomning birinchi so'ziga qarang. Odam yoki joy nomi — the yo'q (**Heathrow** Airport, **Gafur Gulom** Park). Oddiy so'z (white, royal, national, open) yoki nomda **of** — **the** (**the White** House, **the Bank of** England). Mehmonxona, muzey, teatr, gazeta va tashkilot — deyarli doim **the**; ko'cha, do'kon va kompaniya — the siz.

examples.title: Streets, squares and parks: **Navoi Street**, **Hyde Park**
examples.description: Ko'cha, maydon va park nomlari — the siz. Istisnolar: **the High Street**, avtomagistrallar (**the M25**) va **the Silk Road**.

sentences.text: Our office is on **Navoi Street**, opposite a big bookshop.
sentences.translation: Ofisimiz **Navoiy ko'chasida**, katta kitob do'konining qarshisida.

sentences.text: Thousands of people gathered in **Independence Square** to celebrate the national holiday.
sentences.translation: Minglab odamlar milliy bayramni nishonlash uchun **Mustaqillik maydoniga** yig'ilishdi.

sentences.text: If you walk along **Oxford Street** on a Saturday, you'll hardly be able to move.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni **Oksford-strit** bo'ylab yursangiz, qimirlashga ham joy topolmaysiz.

sentences.text: Every Sunday morning James goes running in **Hyde Park** before breakfast.
sentences.translation: Jeyms har yakshanba ertalab nonushtadan oldin **Hayd-parkda** yuguradi.

sentences.text: The new café on **Sayilgoh Street** is always full of students.
sentences.translation: **Sayilgoh ko'chasidagi** yangi kafe doim talabalarga to'la.

sentences.text: We met by the statue in **Amir Temur Square** and then walked to the metro.
sentences.translation: **Amir Temur xiyobonidagi** haykal oldida uchrashdik, keyin metroga piyoda bordik.

sentences.text: Most of the banks in our town are on **the High Street**, next to the post office.
sentences.translation: Shaharchamizdagi banklarning ko'pi **bosh ko'chada**, pochta yonida.

sentences.text: There's been an accident on **the M25**, so traffic around London is moving very slowly.
sentences.translation: **M25** avtomagistralida avariya bo'ldi, shuning uchun London atrofida transport juda sekin harakatlanyapti.

sentences.text: Is **Gafur Gulom Park** far from here, or can we walk there?
sentences.translation: **G'afur G'ulom bog'i** bu yerdan uzoqmi yoki piyoda borsa bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: For centuries caravans travelled along **the Silk Road**, carrying silk, spices and new ideas.
sentences.translation: Asrlar davomida karvonlar **Buyuk Ipak yo'li** bo'ylab ipak, ziravorlar va yangi g'oyalarni olib yurgan.

examples.title: Name + noun: **Heathrow Airport**, **Buckingham Palace**
examples.description: Birinchi so'z — joy yoki odam nomi: aeroport, vokzal, universitet, saroy, qal'a, bozor — the siz.

sentences.text: Our flight leaves from **Tashkent International Airport** at six in the morning.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz **Toshkent xalqaro aeroportidan** ertalab soat oltida uchadi.

sentences.text: Trains to Manchester leave from **Euston Station**, not from **King's Cross**.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga poyezdlar **King's Krossdan** emas, **Yuston vokzalidan** jo'naydi.

sentences.text: Madina got a place at **Samarkand State University** to study foreign languages.
sentences.translation: Madina chet tillarini o'rganish uchun **Samarqand davlat universitetiga** o'qishga kirdi.

sentences.text: Crowds of tourists watch the Changing of the Guard outside **Buckingham Palace**.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar to'p-to'p bo'lib **Bukingem saroyi** oldida soqchilar almashinuvini tomosha qilishadi.

sentences.text: Have you ever visited **Edinburgh Castle**? The view from the walls is amazing.
sentences.translation: **Edinburg qal'asiga** borganmisiz? Devorlaridan ochiladigan manzara ajoyib.

sentences.text: Nilufar is doing a master's degree at **Westminster International University** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Toshkentdagi **Vestminster xalqaro universitetida** magistraturada o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: When we landed at **Heathrow Airport**, the queue for passport control was enormous.
sentences.translation: **Xitrou aeroportiga** qo'nganimizda, pasport nazorati navbati juda uzun edi.

sentences.text: English kings and queens have been crowned in **Westminster Abbey** since 1066.
sentences.translation: 1066-yildan beri Angliya qirol va qirolichalari **Vestminster abbatligida** toj kiyib keladi.

sentences.text: You can find the best dried apricots at **Chorsu Bazaar**, but be ready to bargain.
sentences.translation: Eng yaxshi turshakni **Chorsu bozoridan** topasiz, lekin savdolashishga tayyor turing.

sentences.text: Although **Oxford University** is older, **Cambridge University** has produced more Nobel Prize winners.
sentences.translation: **Oksford universiteti** qadimiyroq bo'lsa-da, **Kembrij universiteti** ko'proq Nobel mukofoti sovrindorlarini yetishtirgan.

examples.title: Adjective first: **the White House**, **the Royal Palace**
examples.description: Nomning birinchi so'zi oddiy sifat yoki ot bo'lsa (white, royal, national, Japanese) — **the** bilan. Atoqli ot bilan boshlanadigan nomlar bilan taqqoslang.

sentences.text: The American president lives and works in **the White House**.
sentences.translation: Amerika prezidenti **Oq uyda** yashaydi va ishlaydi.

sentences.text: In Madrid we visited **the Royal Palace**, which has more than three thousand rooms.
sentences.translation: Madridda **Qirollik saroyiga** bordik, unda uch mingdan ortiq xona bor.

sentences.text: Students often prepare for exams at **the National Library** because it's quiet and free.
sentences.translation: Talabalar ko'pincha imtihonlarga **Milliy kutubxonada** tayyorlanishadi, chunki u yer jim va bepul.

sentences.text: In spring **the Japanese Garden** in Tashkent is full of couples taking wedding photos.
sentences.translation: Bahorda Toshkentdagi **Yapon bog'i** to'y suratiga tushayotgan juftliklarga to'la bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My uncle got his degree from **the Open University** while working full-time.
sentences.translation: Amakim to'liq stavkada ishlab yurib, **Ochiq universitetdan** diplom oldi.

sentences.text: Istanbul's most famous sight is **the Blue Mosque**, just opposite **Hagia Sophia**.
sentences.translation: Istanbulning eng mashhur obidasi — **Ayasofiya** qarshisidagi **Ko'k masjid**.

sentences.text: Have you walked across **the Golden Gate Bridge**, or did you only see it from a boat?
sentences.translation: **Oltin Darvoza ko'prigi** ustidan piyoda o'tdingizmi yoki uni faqat qayiqdan ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: Unlike **Edinburgh Castle**, **the Old Town** around it is free to explore.
sentences.translation: **Edinburg qal'asidan** farqli o'laroq, uning atrofidagi **Eski shaharni** bepul aylanish mumkin.

sentences.text: **The Central Bank** has raised interest rates again to fight inflation.
sentences.translation: **Markaziy bank** inflyatsiyaga qarshi kurashish uchun foiz stavkalarini yana oshirdi.

sentences.text: On Sundays we take the kids either to **Gafur Gulom Park** or to **the Botanical Garden**.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari bolalarni yo **G'afur G'ulom bog'iga**, yo **Botanika bog'iga** olib boramiz.

examples.title: Hotels, museums, theatres: **the Hilton**, **the Odeon**
examples.description: Mehmonxona, muzey, galereya, teatr va kinoteatr — **the** bilan, birinchi so'z atoqli ot bo'lsa ham. Oddiy ot (Hotel, Theatre) ko'pincha tushib qoladi.

sentences.text: We stayed at **the Hilton** because it was close to the conference centre.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya markaziga yaqin bo'lgani uchun **Hilton mehmonxonasida** to'xtadik.

sentences.text: Our conference dinner will be held at **the Hyatt Regency** on Navoi Street.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyaning kechki ziyofati Navoiy ko'chasidagi **Hyatt Regency mehmonxonasida** bo'lib o'tadi.

sentences.text: You could spend a whole week in **the British Museum** and still not see everything.
sentences.translation: **Britaniya muzeyida** butun bir hafta o'tkazsangiz ham, hammasini ko'rib ulgurmaysiz.

sentences.text: Last night we saw a wonderful ballet at **the Navoi Theatre**.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun **Navoiy teatrida** ajoyib balet tomosha qildik.

sentences.text: **The Ilkhom Theatre** in Tashkent was one of the first independent theatres in the Soviet Union.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdagi **Ilhom teatri** Sovet Ittifoqidagi ilk mustaqil teatrlardan biri edi.

sentences.text: Is **the Odeon** still showing that new science fiction film?
sentences.translation: **Odeon kinoteatrida** o'sha yangi ilmiy-fantastik film hali ham ko'rsatilyaptimi?

sentences.text: Kate works as a guide at **the National Gallery**, so she knows every painting by heart.
sentences.translation: Keyt **Milliy galereyada** gid bo'lib ishlaydi, shuning uchun har bir rasmni yoddan biladi.

sentences.text: In Nukus, **the Savitsky Museum** holds one of the world's largest collections of Russian avant-garde art.
sentences.translation: Nukusdagi **Savitskiy muzeyida** dunyodagi eng yirik rus avangard san'ati to'plamlaridan biri saqlanadi.

sentences.text: Do you know if **the Ritz** has a dress code for afternoon tea?
sentences.translation: **Ritz mehmonxonasida** tushlikdan keyingi choy uchun kiyinish qoidasi bor-yo'qligini bilasizmi?

sentences.text: Before visiting **the Amir Temur Museum**, read a little about the Timurid period — it'll make the visit far more interesting.
sentences.translation: **Amir Temur muzeyiga** borishdan oldin Temuriylar davri haqida biroz o'qib oling — tashrif ancha qiziqarli bo'ladi.

examples.title: Names with **of**: **the Tower of London**
examples.description: Nomda **of** bo'lsa — deyarli doim **the**. Universitetlarning ikki nomi: **Oxford University** = **the University of Oxford**.

sentences.text: **The Bank of England** sets the interest rate for the whole of the UK.
sentences.translation: **Angliya banki** butun Buyuk Britaniya uchun foiz stavkasini belgilaydi.

sentences.text: My sister graduated from **the University of Edinburgh** with a degree in medicine.
sentences.translation: Opam **Edinburg universitetini** tibbiyot yo'nalishi bo'yicha tamomlagan.

sentences.text: **The Tower of London** used to be a prison, but now it's one of the city's top attractions.
sentences.translation: **London minorasi** ilgari qamoqxona bo'lgan, hozir esa shaharning eng mashhur diqqatga sazovor joylaridan biri.

sentences.text: Did you know that **the Great Wall of China** can't be seen from space with the naked eye?
sentences.translation: **Buyuk Xitoy devorini** koinotdan oddiy ko'z bilan ko'rib bo'lmasligini bilarmidingiz?

sentences.text: Bekzod works as a researcher at **the National University of Uzbekistan**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **O'zbekiston Milliy universitetida** ilmiy xodim bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: In Tashkent, **the State Museum of History** has a great collection of ancient coins.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdagi **Davlat tarix muzeyida** qadimiy tangalarning ajoyib to'plami bor.

sentences.text: Some people say **Oxford University**, others say **the University of Oxford** — both are correct.
sentences.translation: Ba'zilar **Oxford University**, boshqalar **the University of Oxford** deydi — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

sentences.text: Hurricanes often form over **the Gulf of Mexico** in late summer.
sentences.translation: Yoz oxirida **Meksika ko'rfazi** ustida ko'pincha bo'ronlar paydo bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **The Museum of Applied Arts** is in an old house that once belonged to a Russian diplomat.
sentences.translation: **Amaliy san'at muzeyi** bir paytlar rus diplomatiga tegishli bo'lgan eski uyda joylashgan.

sentences.text: Are **the Houses of Parliament** and **the Palace of Westminster** the same building? — Yes, they're two names for one place.
sentences.translation: **Parlament binosi** va **Vestminster saroyi** bitta binomi? — Ha, bu bir joyning ikki nomi.

examples.title: Shops, companies: **McDonald's**, **Harrods**, **Samsung**
examples.description: Asoschisining nomi bilan atalgan do'kon, restoran va banklar (ko'pincha -'s / -s bilan), avliyo nomidagi soborlar va kompaniyalar — the siz.

sentences.text: Let's grab a quick burger at **McDonald's** before the film starts.
sentences.translation: Film boshlanishidan oldin **McDonald'sda** tezgina bitta burger yeb olaylik.

sentences.text: **Harrods** is so expensive that most tourists only go there to look around.
sentences.translation: **Harrods** shunchalik qimmatki, sayyohlarning ko'pchiligi u yerga faqat aylanib ko'rish uchun boradi.

sentences.text: I usually do my weekly shopping at **Korzinka** because it's open late.
sentences.translation: Haftalik xaridimni odatda **Korzinkada** qilaman, chunki u kechgacha ochiq.

sentences.text: Emma opened a savings account with **Barclays** when she started her first job.
sentences.translation: Emma birinchi ishini boshlaganida **Barclays bankida** jamg'arma hisobi ochdi.

sentences.text: **Uzbekistan Airways** has direct flights from Tashkent to several European cities.
sentences.translation: **Uzbekistan Airways** Toshkentdan bir qancha Yevropa shaharlariga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri reyslarni amalga oshiradi.

sentences.text: My brother has worked for **Samsung** in Seoul for three years.
sentences.translation: Akam uch yildan beri Seulda **Samsung** kompaniyasida ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Visitors who climb to the top of **St Paul's Cathedral** get a fantastic view of the river.
sentences.translation: **Avliyo Pavel soborining** tepasiga chiqqanlar daryoning ajoyib manzarasini ko'rishadi.

sentences.text: We bought sandwiches at **Sainsbury's** and had a picnic in the park.
sentences.translation: **Sainsbury'sdan** sendvich olib, parkda piknik qildik.

sentences.text: Is it true that **Apple** started in a garage in California?
sentences.translation: **Apple** Kaliforniyadagi garajda boshlangani rostmi?

sentences.text: We had dinner at **Nando's** and then went to **the Odeon** to see a film.
sentences.translation: **Nando'sda** kechki ovqat qildik, keyin film ko'rish uchun **Odeon kinoteatriga** bordik.

examples.title: Press and organisations: **the BBC**, **NATO**
examples.description: Gazeta va tashkilotlar — **the** bilan; harfma-harf o'qiladigan qisqartma ham (the BBC, the UN). So'zdek o'qiladigan qisqartma (NATO, UNESCO) va saytlar — the siz.

sentences.text: My father has read **the Guardian** every morning for forty years.
sentences.translation: Otam qirq yildan beri har kuni ertalab **«Guardian»** gazetasini o'qiydi.

sentences.text: According to **the BBC**, the storm will reach the coast by midnight.
sentences.translation: **Bi-bi-si** xabariga ko'ra, bo'ron yarim tunga borib qirg'oqqa yetib keladi.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan joined **the United Nations** in 1992, soon after independence.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston mustaqillikdan ko'p o'tmay, 1992-yilda **Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkilotiga** a'zo bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva are all on **UNESCO's** World Heritage List.
sentences.translation: Samarqand, Buxoro va Xiva — barchasi **YuNESKO** Butunjahon merosi ro'yxatida.

sentences.text: **NATO** was founded in 1949, while **the EU** in its current form dates from 1993.
sentences.translation: **NATO** 1949-yilda tuzilgan, **Yevropa Ittifoqi** esa hozirgi ko'rinishida 1993-yildan beri mavjud.

sentences.text: Sarah got a job at **the World Health Organization** in Geneva after finishing her PhD.
sentences.translation: Sara doktorlik dissertatsiyasini tugatgach, Jenevadagi **Jahon sog'liqni saqlash tashkilotiga** ishga kirdi.

sentences.translation: **«Financial Times»** gazetasidagi o'zbek paxtasi haqidagi maqolani ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.translation: Aziz yangiliklarni **Kun.uz** saytida o'qiydi, chunki u har qanday bosma gazetadan tezkorroq.

sentences.translation: **NASA** va **Yevropa kosmik agentligi** Marsga bir nechta missiya ustida birgalikda ishlamoqda.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a day out in London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st Londonda bir kunlik sayohatni rejalashtiradi — saroy, park, muzey, teatr, do'kon va gazeta nomlari.

sentences.text: — So, Aziz, what shall we see first — **the British Museum** or **Buckingham Palace**?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Aziz, avval nimani ko'ramiz — **Britaniya muzeyinimi** yoki **Bukingem saroyinimi**?

sentences.text: — Let's start with **Buckingham Palace** and then walk through **St James's Park**.
sentences.translation: — **Bukingem saroyidan** boshlaylik, keyin **Sent-Jeyms parki** orqali piyoda o'tamiz.

sentences.text: — Good idea. After that we can have lunch near **Trafalgar Square**.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Undan keyin **Trafalgar maydoni** yaqinida tushlik qilsak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Is that where **the National Gallery** is? I've always wanted to go there.
sentences.translation: — **Milliy galereya** o'sha yerdami? U yerga doim borgim kelgan.

sentences.text: — Exactly, and it's free, unlike **the Tower of London**, which costs a fortune.
sentences.translation: — Xuddi shunday, u bepul — juda qimmat turadigan **London minorasidan** farqli.

sentences.text: — Then let's skip **the Tower** and take a boat along **the Thames** instead.
sentences.translation: — Unda **minorani** qoldirib, o'rniga **Temza** bo'ylab qayiqda sayr qilaylik.

sentences.text: — Great. In the evening my cousin wants to take us to a show at **the Palladium**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Kechqurun amakivachcham bizni **Palladium teatridagi** shouga olib bormoqchi.

sentences.text: — And tomorrow I'd love to buy some souvenirs on **Oxford Street** or at **Harrods**.
sentences.translation: — Ertaga esa **Oksford-stritdan** yoki **Harrodsdan** esdalik sovg'alari olmoqchiman.

sentences.text: — **Harrods** is lovely, but **Camden Market** is much cheaper for souvenirs.
sentences.translation: — **Harrods** ajoyib, lekin esdaliklar uchun **Kamden bozori** ancha arzon.

sentences.text: — Deal! I'll pick up **the Times** at **Waterloo Station** and check tomorrow's weather.
sentences.translation: — Kelishdik! **Vaterloo vokzalidan** **«Times»** gazetasini olib, ertangi ob-havoni ko'rib qo'yaman.
